insights.title: LightGBM Model: 18.6% Dormant Customer Return Probability
insights.data_point: LightGBM classifier (AUC=0.980) trained on 2.2M labelled dormant customers predicts 18.6% of your current dormant base will return within 90 days. Prophet forecasts 256,380 reactivations across Aug–Oct 2026.
insights.deep_analysis: Historical repeat-buyer rate: 51.2% of all customers have made 2+ purchases. The LightGBM model accounts for recency, frequency, monetary value, and inter-purchase gap — giving a per-customer probability score rather than a single flat rate. Customers ranked in the top 20% by model score have 3–5× higher return probability.
insights.recommendation: Target the top-scoring 19% of dormant customers first. At avg Rs 9,211 per return visit, 256,380 expected returners represent Rs 236.2 Cr in potential quarterly revenue.

insights.title: LightGBM: 'Purchase history span' is the #1 Return Predictor
insights.data_point: SHAP analysis of 98% AUC LightGBM model (AUC=0.980) identifies 'Purchase history span' as the strongest predictor of customer return, with 106.2% model weight.
insights.deep_analysis: Customers in the 25th–75th percentile range (0.0 – 896.0) for Purchase history span show significantly higher comeback probability. Beyond this range, the probability drops sharply — providing a precise targeting window for campaigns.
insights.recommendation: Sort your dormant list by Purchase history span and prioritise customers in the 0.0–896.0 range. This single filter can double your campaign ROI vs. blanket outreach.

insights.title: 52.0% of Dormant Customers Are Still Recoverable
insights.data_point: K-Means clustering of 4,311,905 dormant customers reveals 52.0% are 'Warm' (recently lapsed, high purchase history) — 2,241,407 customers with highest recovery potential. 33.1% are in terminal 'Lost' status.
insights.deep_analysis: The 4-tier model (Warm/Cooling/Cold/Lost) prevents budget waste: sending the same campaign to all dormant customers ignores that 'Warm' customers need a gentle nudge while 'Lost' customers need a fundamentally different offer (e.g., deep discount, new product launch). Tailored messaging by tier improves conversion 2–4×.
insights.recommendation: Warm: Standard reminder + loyalty points offer. Cooling: Time-limited discount + personalized product recommendation. Cold: Big-ticket festival offer (Onam/Diwali). Lost: 'We miss you' with maximum available discount.

insights.title: Prophet Forecast: 89,667 Reactivations in Dec 2026
insights.data_point: Facebook Prophet with Onam/Vishu/Christmas seasonal regressors forecasts 85,864 → 80,849 → 89,667 monthly reactivations for Oct 2026, Nov 2026, Dec 2026. Accuracy: 82.6%.
insights.deep_analysis: The Onam season (Aug–Sep) historically drives a 40–75% spike in dormant customer reactivations for Kerala retail. Prophet explicitly models this as a custom regressor — giving a more reliable forecast than generic trend models that don't understand regional festival calendars.
insights.recommendation: Launch your Onam campaign no later than 3 weeks before the predicted peak in Dec 2026. Pre-warm dormant customers in Nov 2026 with a 'Coming Soon' teaser to amplify the natural seasonal surge.
